questions: Should the distance matrix be computed between all samples (X, X) as in the reference, or between samples and centroids, or between centroids themselves, given the prompt says 'between individual samples of the dataset or their centroids'?
If centroids are involved, how should they be derived: as the mean of each cluster based on labels y, or as the centers parameter passed to make_blobs?
Does the plot need to include centroids if distances involve centroids, or only the samples as described?
Should the distance matrix be symmetric (n_samples x n_samples) or possibly rectangular (e.g., n_samples x centers) if centroids are used?
Is the random_seed parameter intended to control both the data generation and any other randomness, or only make_blobs?
Should the function raise an error if centers > n_samples, or handle it gracefully?
If plot_path is provided but invalid (e.g., directory doesn't exist), should the function raise an error or create directories?
Is the distance matrix required to have zeros on the diagonal (self-distances), or should it exclude them?
